title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Resolution Intent and As-Is Appraisal Clause
content:
## Appraisal

After a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases loan is called due, an as-is appraisal is ordered within the plan's appraisal order days, counted in calendar days, and recorded on the case. An appraisal older than the plan's appraisal validity months at the time a payoff or sale is evaluated is replaced by a new one.

## Recording an intent

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "An intent is recorded only from an intent declaration on file for the case whose request status is received and which was made by the living borrower or, for a deceased borrower's loan, by a customer whose profile is successor in interest linked to that borrower, per the plan's successor confirmation setting; a declaration by anyone else is declined as not a confirmed successor."

> *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "An intent is recorded only when the declaration is received no later than the case's response deadline."

Both sentences have been superseded by the current basis.

**Counting at the deadline.** The deadline day itself still counts. A declaration received on any later day is declined as outside the response window. The comparison is made against the case's response deadline as Cedarline's case record shows it, in calendar days, with no grace day (a grace period of 0 days).

**Intent options and no response.**

- The declared intent must be one of the plan's intent options.
- When the response window passes with no valid declaration, the successor intent is recorded as no response on the following day. The case then proceeds toward its resolution deadline, following the plan's no-response handling.
- A later valid declaration within the window replaces an earlier one.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Response deadline | Declaration received | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 12 March | 11 March | within the window |
| 12 March | 12 March | within the window (the deadline day counts) |
| 12 March | 13 March | declined, outside the response window |

If no valid declaration has arrived by 12 March, the successor intent is recorded as no response on 13 March.

superseded_clauses: An intent is recorded only from an intent declaration on file for the case whose request status is received and which was made by the living borrower or, for a deceased borrower's loan, by a customer whose profile_type is successor_in_interest linked to that borrower, per successor_confirmation_required; a declaration by anyone else is declined with reason not_confirmed_successor.
An intent is recorded only when the declaration is received no later than the case's response_deadline.
